Since 0.1.12. The major version stays 0.

### Settings
Settings reads as a console menu. A page's head stays put while its rows scroll, so the title does not slide away, and Up can bring the first row back. The category list fits every category, including About, on the top screen and the smaller bottom one. The other screen names what A does for the row you are on, or what the D-pad does, and then B. A switch that is off keeps a hairline, so it still reads as a switch. About uses the same frame: Foldcade and its version in the head, Copy version info, then Licenses, with Android and the device under the rows (#406).

A long page title, such as a plugin or a folder, wraps onto a second line instead of losing its end (#405).

### Plugins
Settings › Plugins lists each plugin as a card: its art, the name Android shows, its version, and what needs doing on the right. An update waiting says Update available. One that is current says Up to date. One with nothing shared says Off. One you can install says Install. A plugin signed with Foldcade's release key shows Verified. A debug build says Debug on that line, so it does not look like the release beside it (#406).

A plugin's page leads with one row for its release. That row says what A does: Install, Update and the version, Check for updates when it is up to date, or Allow installs when Android has not allowed Foldcade to install apps. While it downloads, the row shows the percent and fills as the file arrives. While Android's dialog is up, the row says Waiting for Android…. If you decline that dialog, the row offers the release again when you come back. Share paired computers and Use for Moonlight games keep a short line under the switch. Version, package, and signer sit under the rows, and the D-pad passes them by. The page title can take two lines (#405, #406).

Install and Update still take Foldcade Moonlight from its latest trusted release. The file still has to be that plugin, newer than what is installed, and signed with Foldcade's release key (#406).

The release asset is `foldcade.apk`.

### Known issues
- The Thor hardware checklist is open. A green emulator run is not a Thor pass. https://github.com/predmore/foldcade/issues/43
- GameNative's own library is not imported. Foldcade reads Home shortcuts and exported `.steam`, `.epic`, `.gog`, `.amazon`, and `.pcgame` files. It does not read GameNative's private database. https://github.com/predmore/foldcade/issues/100
- Android games launched from Foldcade don't record play history, so they don't appear in Recent or Most played.
